theme: Dark Mode Default - Tactical Command Center

rules: Use Chivo for all headers (H1 to H4). Apply tracking-tight or tracking-tighter.
Never use Inter, Roboto, or Open Sans for headings.
Use IBM Plex Sans for body text.
Use IBM Plex Mono for data grids, coordinates, train numbers, and timestamps.
Labels and overlines must be Uppercase, tiny size, and wide spacing (tracking-[0.2em]).
Heading maximum size is text-5xl (fluid). Never exceed this.
Use Deep Obsidian base for structural background.
Use Pure White for data clarity (text).
Avoid vibrating lime colors.
Never use pure #000000. Tint neutral greys slightly with blue.
Buttons/CTAs should use Volt Blue or high-saturation blocks.
Use flat solid backgrounds for surfaces instead of glass to prevent visual refraction of data.
For Dashboard Cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border (border-white/10), no shadow.
Expose the skeleton: Make the grid visible for data-heavy sections (border-collapse style layout).
Never use completely transparent backgrounds under headers or dropdowns.
Base Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 for analytics.
Gap Strategy: Tight (gap-4 or gap-6).
Every pixel must be utilized. Use h-full on children.
Generous spacing inside containers (p-6 or p-8) to prevent text collision with borders.
Override default stretch behavior on grid with align-items: start where needed.
Minimalist animations — use micro-interactions for feedback.
Hover states: Slight lift (-translate-y-1), border color darkens/lightens.
No universal transitions (transition: all). Target specific properties.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion.
Normal text: Min 4.5:1 contrast ratio.
Focus States: Higher contrast than default state (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500).
All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

rules: Do NOT use HTML-based components for advanced interactions.
Use Shadcn UI for standard interactions, customize spacing/radii for technical feel.
Avoid overusing standard cards; prefer borderless dense rows or grid-collapsing table layouts.
Use sonner for toast notifications.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a mission-critical digital twin dashboard.
Do NOT use generic Vercel/Stripe aesthetics. The design must look like a high-end operations control center.
Ensure the sidebar navigation is dense, icon-heavy (Phosphor), and clearly delineates the 7 pages.
The Live Map should be a prominent feature, likely taking up maximum screen real estate on its designated page, overlaying data panels.
Charts (Chart.js) should be styled minimally: remove heavy grid lines, use vibrant tactical colors for lines/bars.
In tailwind.config.js, ensure colors map to the dark/tactical theme variables.
NEVER use placeholders like dummyimage or emoji icons.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid 'AI slop' aesthetic.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
DO NOT apply universal transition (transition: all).
DO NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Main agent must use the provided image URLs. Missing categories = placeholder text, which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
Use modern pill-shaped or sharp buttons with interaction animations.
